config.slot.name: dbz_clinlims_down
config.publication.name: dbz_clinlims_owned
config.heartbeat.action.query: INSERT INTO clinlims.dbz_heartbeat (id, ts) VALUES (1, now()) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET ts = EXCLUDED.ts
config.plugin.name: pgoutput
config.//down: Sends down only the OpenELIS rows in sync/hub-down.conf: register-odoo.sh fills the table list and the aggregate regex from that list, and refuses to register when it cannot. The publication it reads (dbz_clinlims_owned) holds the same tables, with no row filter: the rows keep the clinic's ids, and each clinic's down sink keeps only its own.
config.//origin: Decodes only what was written at this hub. A row a clinic's up-sink applied here carries that clinic's replication origin and is skipped, so the hub publishes a clinic's lab rows only after a hub lab user has written them, and never sends a clinic's own write back to it or on to another clinic.
